reply.text:
Nay, if building muscle or strength is the goal. The research is fairly consistent that cold water right after lifting can blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so I'd keep it away from your hard lifting days or at least a few hours after the session.

It does a decent job of making you feel less beat up, which is why it's popular. If you want it for the feel-good factor or after a run or a hot day, go for it. Just don't count on it to make you grow faster.

If you have a heart condition or any health concern, check with your doctor before plunging. Otherwise, sleep, food and showing up next session will do far more for your recovery than the tub will.
